rule.meaning: A route-local subject cell is eligible only when every declared prerequisite cell has a durable exact PASS completion and every declared prerequisite stage has its exact create-only frozen artifact. A stage is eligible only at its declared boundary when every direct subject cell is exact PASS and every predecessor stage artifact is exact. No failed or invalid input can be replaced by an oracle value.

before_attempt_creation: reopen every required PASS cell completion and its bound attempt, raw result, deterministic score, and completion seal
require verdict PASS and exact true for every required PASS cell
reopen every required stage artifact and require its declared canonical payload, payload hash and bytes, and storage hash and bytes
reject missing, duplicate, out-of-slot, post-failure, out-of-order, mutated, or non-exact inputs

failure_effect.valid_subject_fail: stop that slot permanently before any later attempt is created
failure_effect.controller_invalid: abort all slots; create no later attempts or artifacts

stage_finalization.boundary_semantics: After the named boundary cell has a valid exact PASS completion, exhaustively visit then-current eligible stages in manifest stage_order before creating the next subject attempt.
eligibility: current schedule position is at or beyond finalization_boundary.after_cell_index
every direct_subject_cells member has a durable exact PASS completion in the same slot
every predecessor_stages member has a durable exact artifact in the same slot
the stage artifact path does not already exist
stage_finalization.artifact_payload: exact canonical minified UTF-8 JSON serialization of expected_artifact
stage_finalization.same_payload_reason: Every passing subject output is exact-equal to its frozen expected output, so the deterministic route-local reduction is the frozen expected artifact; a non-equal output is FAIL and stops the slot.
stage_finalization.clean_matrix_requirement: 291 exact PASS cell completions and 54 exact route-local stage artifacts, including one S90 artifact per route
